p.text: Two sentences. Twenty years to understand them.

p.title: MT SANTA INÉS · 1978
p.sub: crude, up and down the Gulf

p.text: She is breathing. Worry when she stops.
The engine eats fuel, the men eat rice. If one of them stops, the ship stops.

p.note: Rubén born — I was home. Pure luck.

p.text: The hardest part is coming home and finding out that home learned to live without you.

p.label: TO LEARN HOW TO COME HOME

p.text: For the first week you are a guest. A very loved guest.

p.label: ROTTERDAM · WINTER
p.sub: after a month in the tropics

p.text: The sea doesn't care how you feel, Chief. And neither does the gas.

p.note: Fuel spray fire — out in 40 s
Father's funeral — on a video call

p.text: If you only love the money, the sea will find out.
Down here, you will be afraid many times. Be afraid after. During, you work.
And when it is after, call your wife. Not to tell her what happened. To hear her voice.
